property_summary: For every non-empty array `_tos` of recipients, `c.transfer(from, caddress, _tos, v)` returns true iff the external `transferFrom(from, _tos[i], v)` call succeeds for every i, so an empty array must not silently succeed with `return true`; the buggy `require(_tos.length >= 0)` allows the empty-array case to return true without making any external call, which a recording helper can detect because no `transferFrom` call is observed.
change_summary: Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) guard with require(_tos.length >= 0), making the function return true for empty input arrays instead of reverting.
